title: Chess by Wire
purpose: A subscriber plays chess against another household across the province, one move a night
style: Felt-green and parchment board with programmable-character pieces beside a navy score panel
techniques: DRCS chess pieces with outline passes
a DRCS knight as the service mark
the move shown arriving by WAIT

title: The Maze
purpose: A subscriber walks a dungeon adventure one step at a time, choosing a direction by number
style: Stone corridor in graded perspective trapezoids, torchlit, with a glowing door and a mosaic map
techniques: perspective trapezoids in graded colour-map entries
one DRCS arrow turned by TEXT rotation
eyes in the dark by BLINK

title: Quiz Night
purpose: A household plays the evening quiz against the clock and the rest of the city
style: Game-show panels in four saturated answer colours on deep violet
techniques: WAIT countdown dial overdrawn slice by slice
colour-map reveal dimming the wrong answers

title: Gallery Page: Harbour at Dusk
purpose: The service's gallery shows a videotex artist's harbour, built layer by layer as the viewer watches
style: Layered flat-colour landscape in a garish sunset palette, after the period videotex painters
techniques: elliptical sky bands round the sun
colour-map dusk in three WAIT steps
windows, stars, quay lamps and portholes lit by one SET COLOR
two lighthouse beams sweeping by staggered BLINK
rigging and pennants in single lines

title: The Lace Picture
purpose: A decorative gallery piece: geometry, the thing the new terminals drew best, made into lace
style: Cream and gold lace on midnight blue with ground-colour cut-outs
techniques: dotted line texture for running stitches

title: Story Time: The Garden
purpose: A children's story page whose picture draws itself as an animation while the line of text waits below
style: Picture-book flat colour: a soil cross-section, a kneeling child and a flower that opens
techniques: petals hidden in sky colour then revealed by SET COLOR
filled arcs and rotated petal polygons
a bee arriving in the last stage
a picket fence, cottage and clouds for setting

title: The Chat Line
purpose: Subscribers talk in a late-night chat room; the service listens and the screen scrolls
style: Night-blue room with a colour-coded member list, programmable-character badges and a blinking heart
techniques: DRCS badges for each member, in the list and before each line
night window with curtains in the member column
proportional text in colour per speaker

title: The Face Maker
purpose: A family builds a cartoon face from numbered parts and sends it on as a card
style: Big flat-colour cartoon face in a photo-booth frame beside a numbered parts menu
techniques: BLINK on the part being changed
filled arcs for smile and cheeks
a rounded nose and inner ears
pleated curtains with a scalloped valance
DRCS part icons in the menu

title: Download Tonight's Program
purpose: The service sends a program to the home computer, frame by frame, while the family waits
style: Navy night with a broadcast mast, a stream of digits, a beige home computer, a floppy and a cassette
techniques: mosaic progress bar filled frame by frame with WAIT
digits set along an arc one WAIT apart
a town of aerials under the signal
a desk and a mug for the room
the program listing on the screen

title: New Year's Eve 1990
purpose: The city service greets a new decade: a countdown, then fireworks over the skyline
style: Midnight skyline and river under multicoloured bursts, a greeting set along an arc
techniques: bursts of lines, one colour-map entry each
BLINK colour cycling with staggered delays
